Start your trial See pricing Straight answers Common questions What is ClipperDesk? + ClipperDesk is appointment scheduling and service business management software for beauty, wellness, personal care, fitness, recovery, health and pet-care teams. It connects booking with the working calendar, client context, checkout and reporting. Who is ClipperDesk built for? + ClipperDesk supports independent professionals and appointment-led businesses with one or more locations, including teams with a shared front desk. Dedicated pages explain the fit and limits for each supported business type. How is this different from a booking-only tool? + Appointments connect to your calendar, client history, checkout and reports. You can also manage walk-ins alongside scheduled visits. How do payments and client notifications work? + Checkout records payments received outside ClipperDesk; it does not charge cards or send provider refunds. Online deposit collection is not currently available. Email and SMS notifications require enabled delivery providers, and SMS also requires client consent and available credits. Can I bring existing data with me? + ClipperDesk includes CSV imports for clients, staff, services and products. Imports preview validation errors and duplicate candidates before valid rows are added to your business. Run the next working day with confidence. pages.main_text: Home / Features / Calendar and walk-ins Calendar and walk-ins Manage appointments and walk-ins together Coordinate staff schedules, chairs and rooms, appointment changes and waiting clients. Overview The calendar brings scheduled visits, staff availability and walk-ins into one view. Your workflow How it works 01 See the day in useful views View today, a day or week, or separate staff schedules. Filter by location, professional, service or status. 02 Update appointments Reschedule appointments, assign staff, change services, mark no-shows or block time. 03 Fit walk-ins around appointments See estimated waits and check staff and space before starting a walk-in service. 04 Recover from exceptions Review appointments affected by late arrivals, delays, staff absences or closures. What you can do Appointment labels and icons show status alongside colour. If someone else updates an appointment, review the latest version before saving. Managers can approve policy exceptions but cannot double-book staff or space. Important limits Wait times are estimates and can change with service delays or staff availability. Existing room and equipment requirements are checked where configured. The service editor does not provide advanced resource or treatment-layout editing. Published 2026-08-16 · Updated 2026-10-13 · ClipperDesk editorial team A practical field guide for the working week. 01 Set your business details and opening hours Confirm display name, time zone, currency, address/contact context and the local opening intervals that determine bookable time. 02 Make services schedulable Give each service an accurate duration, price, eligible staff and any processing, cleanup, add-on or physical-resource requirement. 03 Make staff availability explicit Record each person’s location assignment, working intervals, breaks and service eligibility before relying on public availability. 04 Preview before publishing Check your policy, booking questions and available services in the preview, then publish your page when setup is complete. Keep beside you Working checklist Business name, time zone and currency Location details and weekly hours Service duration, price and eligibility Staff assignments, hours and breaks Resource quantities where needed Booking/deposit/cancellation policy Preview and check required setup This checklist does not replace tax, employment, licensing, safety, insurance or privacy advice for a specific service business.
